description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Bimal Niroshan Rathnayake Weerakoon as a member of the Eighth Parliament
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy due to a resignation, as outlined in the Parliamentary Elections Act. It involves the procedural steps for declaring a new Member of Parliament elected to fill a seat vacated by a member of a recognized political party. The content is directly related to electoral processes and declarations, falling under the Elections category (Type 7).
